[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was a son of [[Glasgow-2847|John Glasgow]] and [[Anderson-83671|Margaret Anderson]], associated with a 1747 baptism at West Calder, Midlothian, Scotland.<ref name="Baptism">FamilySearch, "Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950", [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4T-R5D John Glasgow, 1747], cited for the son of John Glasgow and Margaret Anderson at West Calder. The original register entry has not been inspected in this research.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2847]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The held citation specifically identifies John’s 1747 West Calder entry as son of John Glasgow and Margaret Anderson. This is the adult Anderson household represented by the father account; the later Pennsylvania/Kilwaughter comparisons remain separate.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

Next useful test: Read the original West Calder child entry for the complete parental pair; investigate John’s childhood independently.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4T-R5D FamilySearch, John Glasgow,1747, West Calder, John Glasgow/Margaret Anderson; exact date remains a prior research question]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4T-R5D "Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4T-R5D : 12 February 2020), John Glasgow, 1747.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


'''Birth and baptism.''' His exact birth date is not established. The date 6 September 1747 needs checking against the baptism index and original register before it can be treated as an exact baptism date or used to establish a precise birth limit.<ref name="Baptism" />

'''Larne namesake.''' [[Glasgow-4179|John Glasgow of Larne]] married [[Allan-6611|Rose Allan]] in 1769 according to the Kilwaughter/Larne family chronology. That chronology does not name the groom's parents or connect him to West Calder. No evidence identified here establishes that the Scottish child and the Larne groom were the same man; their identities remain separate.<ref name="Timeline">Donna Jean Glasgow, [https://web.archive.org/web/20101124184247id_/http://lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Kilwaughter/Timeline.html "GLASGOWS from Kilwaughter Parish and Larne, County Antrim, Northern Ireland … Timeline"] (archived 24 November 2010), entry: "13. John3 Glasgow m. Rose Allan in 1769. Born perhaps 1745-48? Probably not the same as John2 who was a ship’s captain in 1739." This is evidence about the Larne groom, not proof of a marriage for the West Calder child.</ref>

=== Possible John Glascow, Chester County land and committee ===
John Glascow is an adjoining landholder in a West-Nottingham Township, Chester County execution-sale notice for 22½ acres, late Michael Dintz’s estate, bounded by Abraham Bunting, John Glascow and others.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/39401494/ The Pennsylvania Gazette, 1773-04-28, p.1].</ref><ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/39401765/ The Pennsylvania Gazette, 1773-05-05, p.5].</ref>

John Glascow is appointed to provide for distressed families of Associators in actual service by the Chester County Committee of Inspection and Observation, in a resolution dated 13 August 1776.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/39398635/ The Pennsylvania Gazette, 1776-08-28, p.3].</ref>

The adjoining-owner and committee appointments may concern one man but do not name his parents or wife. They require an active adult in 1773 and 1776; the John who died in May 1769 cannot be that living participant.

This may concern [[Glasgow-2846]]. Chronologically compatible; no death date or Pennsylvania evidence.
